fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2026-02-10 states that a gold chain weighing about 6 sovereigns was snatched from the complainant near Mynthan Colony Main Street in Erode by a person riding a maroon motorcycle bearing registration number TN-47-ZZ-1038, on 2026-02-10 around 07:05 hrs. The complaint was lodged by Revathi Bai (9000000313). Pandian Balan (9000000285) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Vignesh Babu (9000000271), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complaint mentions Thirumal Velan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000384, in connection with the events. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly snatched the chain from a passing two-wheeler.
fields.Keywords: chain snatching, two-wheeler, associate, motorcycle, morning, main street, vehicle observation, witness
